integrity: The proof is self-contained; the verifier independently checks small complete incidence matrices, random matrices, path extremizers, and the distinct anchored recurrence. scientific_limitations: Applies to finite, typed bipartite relations under simultaneous Z-rule updates with all three premises from the preceding round. The limiting difunctional closure and the anchored original-relation iteration are classical; neither is asserted new.
